title: STARTEX — Badge Cloning & Physical-Cyber Convergence

fields.location: North Coast International Airport (NCIA), Akron, Ohio
fields.weather: Partly cloudy, 58°F. Light wind from the northeast.
fields.load: Moderate: 12 flights scheduled, 3 in departure hold, 1 delayed.
fields.staffing: Full shift coverage across Operations, IT, Security, and Emergency Management.
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 07:42 AM on Thursday, October 22, 2026, at North Coast Regional Airport Authority. A duplicate badge has been detected in the access logs. The event has not yet been confirmed as malicious, but the pattern matches a known threat vector. Your team must determine whether this is an error, a test, or a breach. The answer is not in the alert — it is in the logs, the footage, and the physical trail.
